summary: The gallery picture of the staircase is an informative image with no alt attribute.
fixed_by: The image has an alt attribute that describes what the drawing shows.

summary: The gallery picture of the bookcase has a file name as its text alternative, which says nothing about the image.
fixed_by: The alt text describes the bookcase shown in the drawing.

summary: The hero introduction is light grey (#a3aaad) on cream (#f4f1ea), a contrast ratio of about 2.1:1 for normal-size text.
fixed_by: The paragraph uses the body text colour (#1f2a30), about 13:1 on the same background.

summary: The link inside the services introduction is not underlined and differs from the surrounding text by colour only, with a contrast of about 1.9:1 against that text.
fixed_by: Links in running text are underlined.

summary: The "See our prices" button link has its focus outline removed and shows no other focus indicator.
fixed_by: The link keeps the site-wide 3px focus outline.

summary: The "Services" sub-menu is opened by a div with an inline click handler: it cannot receive keyboard focus and exposes no role or expanded state, so the three sub-menu links are unreachable without a mouse (same element also fails 4.1.2).
fixed_by: A button with aria-expanded and aria-controls toggles the sub-menu; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.

summary: The testimonials carousel changes slide every 4 seconds with no control to pause or stop it, and keeps rotating while it is hovered or focused.
fixed_by: A pause button is the first control of the carousel; rotation also stops on hover and focus, and does not start when reduced motion is requested.

summary: The previous and next buttons of the carousel contain only a decorative SVG and have no accessible name.
fixed_by: Each button contains visually hidden text: "Previous testimonial" and "Next testimonial".

summary: The three slide picker buttons are 14 by 14 CSS pixels with 4 pixels between them.
fixed_by: The picker buttons are 44 by 44 CSS pixels and show their number.

summary: The hero badge pulses in an endless CSS animation that starts on load, cannot be paused and ignores the prefers-reduced-motion setting.
fixed_by: The badge plays one 0.6 second entrance, only when the user has not asked for reduced motion.

summary: The video has sound but no captions track.
fixed_by: The video has a track element of kind captions pointing to a WebVTT file.

summary: The callback pop-up is a plain div: it has no dialog role, no modal state and no accessible name.
fixed_by: A native dialog element opened with showModal() and named by its heading through aria-labelledby.

summary: Activating "Request a callback" opens the pop-up but leaves focus on the page behind it: focus is not moved into the pop-up, is not kept inside it, Escape does not close it and focus is not returned on close.
fixed_by: The native modal dialog receives focus, makes the rest of the page inert, closes on Escape and gives focus back to the opening button.

summary: The main content is wrapped in a div instead of a main landmark, so the page has no main region and its content sits outside any landmark.
fixed_by: The content is wrapped in a main element.

summary: The workshop motto is a French sentence inside an English page with no lang attribute.
fixed_by: The French passage is wrapped in an element with lang="fr".

summary: A link that stands alone in its paragraph reads "Click here": neither its text nor its context tells where it leads.
fixed_by: The link text states its purpose: "Request a quote for a similar project".

summary: The phone link of the hero contains only a decorative SVG hidden from assistive technology, so the link has no accessible name.
fixed_by: The link contains visible text next to the icon.

summary: The notice bar is fixed to the bottom of the viewport (about 136 CSS pixels high at a 1280 pixel width) and entirely covers controls that receive keyboard focus behind it, such as the transcript toggle, the download link and the footer links.
fixed_by: The notice bar is in the normal flow at the top of the page, and scroll-padding keeps focused elements clear of the sticky header.

summary: The gallery grid has three fixed 300px columns, so the page scrolls horizontally at a width of 320 CSS pixels.
fixed_by: The grid uses auto-fill columns with a 12rem minimum and reflows to a single column.

summary: The before/after comparison can only be operated by dragging its handle with a pointer; there is no single-pointer alternative (the same element is not keyboard operable either, 2.1.1).
fixed_by: A labelled native range input controls the comparison: it works by click, tap and arrow keys.

summary: The price table has no header cells: column and row headings are td elements styled in bold.
fixed_by: Column headings are th scope="col" and row headings th scope="row".

summary: In the hourly rates table the Saturday row header has the id r-saturday while the cells of that row list r-weekend in their headers attribute, an id that does not exist.
fixed_by: Every id listed in a headers attribute exists on a header cell of the same table.

summary: The "Order book" column shows an empty green or red dot with no text: availability is conveyed by colour alone.
fixed_by: Each cell contains the words "Open" or "Waiting list" next to an icon whose shape also differs.

summary: The title element of the page is empty.
fixed_by: The title names the page and the site: "Price guide – Brindle & Oak Joinery".

summary: The skip link points to #content, an id that does not exist on the page, so it does nothing.
fixed_by: The skip link points to the id of the main element.

summary: The viewport meta element sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no, which prevents pinch zoom.
fixed_by: The viewport is width=device-width, initial-scale=1 with no zoom restriction.

summary: Choosing an option in the "Check typical prices first" list loads another page at once, with no warning and no button.
fixed_by: The list is followed by a "Go to the price guide" submit button; nothing happens until it is activated.

summary: The email field has no programmatic label: its visible label is a span that is not associated with the input.
fixed_by: A label element is associated with the input through for and id.

summary: The phone field has autocomplete="nope", which is not a valid token, so its purpose cannot be determined.
fixed_by: The field has autocomplete="tel".

summary: The four "Type of work" radio buttons are grouped in a div with a paragraph as their question: there is no fieldset, legend or group role.
fixed_by: The radio buttons are in a fieldset whose legend is the question.

summary: When the form is submitted with missing or invalid values, the fields in error only get a red border: no text message, no aria-invalid, nothing announced, and focus does not move.
fixed_by: Each error is written as text next to its field and linked with aria-describedby and aria-invalid; an error summary listing links to the fields receives focus.

summary: The confirmation shown after a successful submission is inserted into a paragraph that is not a live region, so it is not announced.
fixed_by: The paragraph has role="status" and is present in the page before the message is written.

summary: The address and postcode typed under "Your details" must be typed again under "Where the work will take place", with no way to reuse them.
fixed_by: A "Same as my address above" checkbox, ticked by default, hides the second address; it is only asked for when the box is unticked.

summary: The submit button shows "Send request" but its aria-label is "Submit form": the accessible name does not contain the visible label.
fixed_by: The button has no aria-label; its name is its visible text.

summary: The html element has no lang attribute.
fixed_by: The html element has lang="en".

summary: A meta refresh reloads the page after 600 seconds, which clears what was typed; the user cannot turn off, adjust or extend this limit.
fixed_by: The page has no timed refresh.

summary: The password field cancels paste events and sets autocomplete="off": the password must be recalled and typed by hand, with no alternative way to sign in.
fixed_by: Pasting is allowed and the field has autocomplete="current-password", so password managers can fill it.

summary: The "Need help? Call…" line sits in the header after the navigation on every other page, but at the very end of the footer on this one.
fixed_by: The help line is in the header, after the navigation, on every page.

summary: The email and password fields are delimited only by a 1px #d5d9db border on white, a contrast of about 1.4:1.
fixed_by: Fields have a 2px #6b7478 border, about 4.8:1 on white.

summary: A script sends focus back to the email field whenever it loses focus without holding a valid address: once inside, a keyboard user cannot leave it with Tab or Shift+Tab.
fixed_by: The field is validated on submission only and never takes focus back.
